Matrix summary:
- Sequence lengths: 4k, 32k, 128k, 512k (max stress)

- Metrics captured: P50/P95/P99 latency (ms), TTFT (ms) first token + full response, throughput (tokens/sec), error rates, GPU mem/util, KV-cache hit ratio, per-request trace IDs

- We will pin a single model variant across runs for comparability.
- Use deterministic RNG for synthetic prompts; real-sample runs will be nondeterministic to exercise model branchiness.
